# Exergy

> Exergy (Exergy LLC, Denver, CO) designs building energy systems powered by bitcoin miners. Heat recovery and solar monetization are separate value streams. Integration can be hydronic or forced air. Exergy does not sell hardware. Work is scoped per project. Phase 0, a feasibility check from about 12 months of utility bills, is free.

## Pages

- [Home](https://exergyheat.com/): the offer, the project phases, the Denver office, and open tools
- [Commercial](https://exergyheat.com/commercial): building integrated mining for building owners
- [Partners](https://exergyheat.com/partners): market entry for manufacturers of miners, heaters, boilers, and water heaters
- [Operations](https://exergyheat.com/operations): workflow audits for energy adjacent businesses
- [About](https://exergyheat.com/about): the name, the team, open source, the book, and the Heatpunk Summit
- [Contact](https://exergyheat.com/contact): feasibility, partnership, operations, and the homeowner pilot
- [Privacy policy](https://exergyheat.com/privacy-policy)
